A.notes: Tidy azulejo/kingfisher guide with all requested sections, but template-like. Fails G1: white caption text over light photo areas (1.17:1), 6.5-9px text on packaging, terracotta eyebrow 3.35:1. Mobile: primary lockup touches card edge, nav truncated, 6 small touch targets, no reduced-motion rule, few interaction states. Logo is generic; applications are simple illustrations.

B.notes: Strong concept: roast-curve device with scrubber, one disc-and-crease mark, editorial serif+mono system, measured rules, contrast table, say/not voice examples, tabbed samples, roast-level packaging system. Audit passes all gates, but by eye the 390px hero has the terracotta disc overlapping the headline and body copy (dark on ember), so I fail G1 on mobile. Minor: misuse tiles clip on mobile, clearspace diagram cramped, 4 font families.

why: B has a real signature idea, rigorous and specific guidelines, and far richer interaction and states. Its mobile hero overlap needs fixing, but A is generic and also fails contrast.
